The grey zones on each preview
The bottom ten inches roll into the stand's base and the top three sit under the rail, so they are shaded here. The printed file still fills them with the ground colour so nothing shows a seam. Every word and the QR sit in the clear zone; the QR is five inches square, about 30 inches off the floor.
